title: Concept: Raw-markup binding (javascript: dangerouslySetInnerHTML) — review required
description: In javascript, dangerouslySetInnerHTML disables the framework's automatic escaping for one binding. Raw-markup bindings exist for trusted rich text, but any untrusted bytes in the value become script. The remedy is text binding via text children or DOMPurify.sanitize.
applicability: javascript templates and components using the raw binding; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-site scripting, usually stored; MEDIUM severity, HIGH on authenticated pages.
